control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas
authorisation of switching and access to apparatus

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: audit finding - critical control verification of critical control at SG-9000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus on SG-9000 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically working live under a documented justification. SG-9000 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 14 November 2016 a planned critical control verification of SG-9000 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop found the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas not effective.
